key_insight: MR-ConceptGCN models learners with multi-relational graph convolutions plus semantic embeddings to capture both what concepts they missed and the order of their interactions.
engineering_relevance: The method is relevant for personalized learning systems because it provides a more expressive user model for educational recommenders than homogeneous-graph approaches.
method: Build personal knowledge graphs from learner interactions in CourseMapper.
Use multi-relational GCNs and SBERT to learn relation- and semantic-aware concept embeddings.
Combine enriched concept representations into a sequential learner model with long-term and short-term interaction signals.
evidence_signal: An online user study with 31 participants reported improvements in accuracy, usefulness, diversity, and satisfaction.
watch_item: The evaluation is relatively small and user-study based, so broader generalization and deployment robustness still need validation.
paper_title: Sequential Learner Modeling Using Multi-Relational Graph Convolutional Networks
